title: Seeking past seekable end (50fps UHD HEVC video with CBR)
product-requirement: Client must have access to expected events and properties after seeking past seekable end.
specification: [HTML] If the (possibly now changed) new playback position is not in one of the ranges given in the seekable attribute, then let it be the position in one of the ranges given in the seekable attribute that is the nearest to the new playback position.
assertion: After seeking past the seekable end, currentTime must be no greater than the closest seekable end.
